description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pahala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420500 - File No. 14/0416 Pannala
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration, ownership transfers, and property title determinations, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
